body:
## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `a11y` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. The family's third member, so it carries the enumeration pin

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T13:56Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `groupedPager` in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is `domain:ui`.
- **Why p3:** a screen reader announces four unnamed buttons on every multi-page grouped grid. Sighted use is unaffected. That is the grade of #12124 and #11690.
- **Direction, as filed:** an `aria-label` through `useGridTranslation`, using the four `table.*` keys PR #12142 adds, plus four `GRID_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` rows, with no literal English. The positional test lookup moves to a role and name query.
- **The family:** icon-only buttons with no accessible name: #11690 (view tab bar), #12124 (data-table pager), and now this card. On the third occurrence the fix includes an **enumeration pin**:
  - a census test over `packages/*/src` (tests excluded) of icon-only `Button`s, meaning those whose only child is an icon component, that carry neither `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `title` nor visually hidden text;
  - it ratchets, so the count never rises; the claim measures today's number first;
  - the `DetailView.tsx` `recordNavigation` pair the filer found goes into the census, ⛔ not into this card's fix.

  It is a test in the package's own suite, ⛔ not a new CI gate (「新增门禁默认否」).
- **Sequence:** after PR #12142 (which adds the keys) and objectui#12110's in-flight claim on `ObjectGrid.tsx`. This is ordering, not a block. `Clause-②: no`.
